messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need a tiny hotfix for 2.7.1, memory leak in kv-evict path seen in eu-west-prod this morning. hoping to ship today with minimal diff.
ajay: ack. when's the cutoff?
devon: +1. can we keep it to a single-file revert/change? reduces review overhead.
maria: cutoff 16:00 UTC for merge to release/2.7.x. smoke by 17:00. any PRs after cutoff go to triage-next.
emma: I'll open the PR in a few mins. plan: patch bump 2.7.1 -> 2.7.2, single change in runtime/kv/evict.go to guard nil slice and add a small unit test.
li: FYI please include a changelog line under "bugfix" and mark as hotfix. low-risk wording.
ajay: suggested cherry-pick/branch commands:```bash
git checkout -b fix/kv-evict-hotfix release/2.7.x
git commit -m "kv: guard nil in evict handler (hotfix)"
git push origin fix/kv-evict-hotfix
# open PR against release/2.7.x
```
oliver: CI note — make sure the perf job (nightly) is skipped for this branch, but run the smoke and e2e-quick. I'll patch the pipeline if needed.
release-bot: [CI] run started for PR #1389 — smoke, unit, e2e-quick queued.
maria: reviewers: @devon for runtime, @ajay for backport correctness. if both approve by cutoff, i'll merge and tag.
devon: will review now. tiny change looks fine but double-check race on the kv cache pointer — left a comment.
emma: addressed devon's comment, pushed. also bumped module version to 2.7.2 in go.mod.
ajay: pinging release infra — can you reserve a canary slot at 10% traffic for east/us for 30m after deploy? fallback to previous model variant if latency > 120ms.
oliver: reserved canary window 16:30-17:00 UTC, 10% us-east. automated rollback hook set on latency/regression threshold.
release-bot: [CI] smoke passed, unit tests passed. e2e-quick failed on unrelated flaky test (test/cli/timeout). marking as flaky and re-running e2e-quick.
maria: re-run ok? we need green before merge.
emma: re-run fixed the flaky test, all green now. ready for merge.
devon: approved. ajay?
ajay: approved, merging now. I'll tag 2.7.2 and trigger the release workflow.
release-bot: [Release] tag v2.7.2 created. Deployment scheduled 16:30 UTC to canary targets.
maria: thanks team. post-merge checklist: update changelog PR with full note, run quick smoke on eu-west, and monitor error rate + heap profile for 2 hours.
oliver: monitoring dashboards pinned, alerts set for heap growth and OOMs. will escalate if anything odd.
release-bot: [Deploy] canary rollout started (10% us-east).
ajay: seeing normal traffic so far. memory stable on canary instances.
maria: if canary stable at 17:00, roll to 100% with 30m ramp.
release-bot: [Deploy] canary healthy at 16:45. scheduled ramp to 100% at 17:00 UTC.
emma: updating internal release notes and adding changelog entry now.
oliver: will run the heap-dump job at +1h just in case.
maria: closing thread after full ramp. thanks everyone :clap:
release-bot: [Deploy] rollout complete at 17:22 UTC — 100% traffic on v2.7.2.
